name: QuickBundles – WooCommerce Product Bundles
author: Logik Labs

sections.description:
QuickBundles transforms your WooCommerce store by enabling you to create compelling product bundles that drive sales and increase average order value. Whether you’re running a flash sale, creating product kits, or offering combo deals, QuickBundles provides all the tools you need to succeed.

Developed by LogikLabs – experts in innovative WordPress plugin solutions designed to elevate functionality, boost performance, and deliver seamless results for your website.

Why Choose QuickBundles?

  • Increase Sales: Create irresistible product combinations that encourage larger purchases
  • Save Time: Intuitive interface makes bundle creation quick and easy
  • Boost Conversions: Add urgency with countdown timers and limited-time offers
  • Flexible Pricing: Set bundle-wide discounts or customize pricing per product
  • Customer Satisfaction: Give your customers better value with thoughtfully crafted bundles
  • Expert Support: Backed by LogikLabs’ expertise in WordPress plugin development

Key Features

  • Advanced Bundle Creation

    • Combine any number of products into attractive bundles
    • Set minimum and maximum quantities per product
    • Optional products and variable product support
    • Bulk bundle management

  • Smart Pricing Options

    • Percentage or fixed amount discounts
    • Individual product discounts
    • Bundle-wide discount rules
    • Automatic price calculations

  • Marketing Tools

    • Countdown timers for urgency
    • Limited-time offers
    • Custom bundle layouts
    • Stock management integration

  • User-Friendly Interface

    • Drag-and-drop bundle builder
    • Real-time price calculations
    • Bulk editing capabilities
    • Responsive design

Use Cases

  • Flash Sales and Limited-Time Offers: Create urgency with time-limited bundle deals
  • Product Kits and Starter Packs: Bundle complementary products for new customers
  • Complementary Product Combinations: Increase order value with smart product pairings
  • Bulk Purchase Discounts: Encourage higher quantity purchases with tiered pricing
  • Holiday Season Bundles: Create seasonal offers with themed product combinations
  • Gift Sets and Special Occasions: Pre-configured bundles for birthdays, anniversaries, and more

Pro Features Coming Soon

  • Advanced Analytics and Reports
  • AI-Powered Bundle Suggestions
  • Custom Bundle Templates
  • Advanced Stock Management
  • Multiple Bundle Layouts
  • Additional Marketing Tools

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

  • Chakra UI (Version 2.8.2)
    • License: MIT
    • Website: https://chakra-ui.com
    • Purpose: Provides modern UI components for the admin interface
    • Location: /assets/vendor/chakra-ui/chakra-ui.min.css

All third-party libraries are included locally within the plugin to ensure reliability and performance. No external CDN calls are made.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/quickbundles directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. Use the QuickBundles menu in your admin panel to create and manage bundles
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, QuickBundles requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated as it extends WooCommerce functionality to create product bundles.

Can I set different discounts for different products in a bundle?

Yes, you can set both bundle-wide discounts and individual product discounts, giving you complete flexibility in your pricing strategy.

Is the plugin compatible with variable products?

Yes, QuickBundles fully supports variable products, allowing customers to select their preferred variations within bundles.

Can I limit the availability of bundles?

Absolutely! You can create limited-time offers using our built-in countdown timer functionality to create urgency and boost conversions.

Does QuickBundles work with my theme?

QuickBundles is designed to work with any properly coded WooCommerce theme. The frontend display adapts to your theme’s styling.

What happens if a product in a bundle goes out of stock?

The plugin intelligently handles stock management and will notify customers if a product in the bundle becomes unavailable.

What third-party libraries does this plugin use?

The plugin uses Chakra UI (version 2.8.2) for its admin interface components. The library is included locally with the plugin and does not require any external connections.

Is there a premium version available?

We’re currently developing our Pro version with advanced features. Stay tuned for the release announcement!
